name: Umeclidinium
dosing: Inhaled: 55mcg OD (often combined with vilanterol as Anoro)
contraindications: Known hypersensitivity to umeclidinium or formulation components, severe hypersensitivity to other antimuscarinic agents
interactions: Additive antimuscarinic effects when combined with other anticholinergic drugs; caution with medications that may exacerbate urinary retention or narrow-angle glaucoma
monitoring: Monitor respiratory function (spirometry), symptom control and for antimuscarinic adverse effects such as urinary retention and dry mouth
pregnancy: Avoid unless essential and after specialist discussion
sideEffects: Dry mouth, upper respiratory tract infection, cough; local antimuscarinic effects predominate with minimal systemic effects
pharmacokinetics: Administered by inhalation with low systemic exposure and once-daily activity
clinicalPearls: Once-daily long-acting muscarinic antagonist useful for maintenance therapy in COPD; commonly combined with a LABA for improved bronchodilation; choose therapy based on symptom burden and exacerbation risk
indication: Maintenance bronchodilator therapy in COPD (often used in combination inhalers)
